reason: josh start gains a new pre-write refusal for a missing git author identity (#3754): the commit-step predicate, the git identity probe, the refusal and its hint, and the fresh-machine pattern's identity line. The review round added two cases the probe has to tell apart — a git that could not be started is not a missing identity, and a plan that creates the repository asks from where it will be so a per-directory identity counts — new behavior with no existing code to fold it into
